SFO.menuHint: Assign and align a different fog image for each player and scene Level.
SFO.managerHint: Choose an image for each player and floor. Paths save when changed; use Align to position and stretch the image. Explored areas stay revealed until the GM resets fog.
SFO.fogDisabled: Enable Token Vision and fog exploration in Scene Configuration. Overlays are inactive without persistent fog.
SFO.sharedFog: Shared exploration is enabled: images are individual, but explored areas are shared. Use individual fog exploration for separate player knowledge.
SFO.noLevels: No scene Levels found. Create a native Level in Scene Configuration, or migrate the old scene with Levels 7.x first.
SFO.noPlayers: Create a player user to assign an image.
SFO.levelsHint: Foundry v14 native Levels, including migrated Levels scenes. GMs always retain their normal map view.
SFO.alignmentHint: Drag the preview to move it. Drag side or corner handles to stretch either axis independently. X/Y are the unrotated image's top-left in canvas pixels; rotation is around its centre. Escape cancels a drag.
SFO.previewOnly: GM-only alignment preview, not the player's explored-fog view. Players receive changes only when you save. Switching scene or floor closes this preview without saving.
SFO.chooseImage: Choose an image in this cell first.
SFO.canvasBusy: Wait for the current scene to finish loading, then try again.
SFO.previewUnavailable: Preview unavailable. Check the image path and the currently viewed floor.
SFO.error: Silverlane: operation failed. See the browser console for details; check permissions, image path and Level.
SFO.tileRestrict: Restrict this tile to the selected players
SFO.tileHint: If restricted and nobody is selected, no players see this tile. GMs always see it. Native hidden/Level rules still apply. This is a visual filter, not file security; light and weather restrictions remain shared.
